correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 65,535 nonempty edge subsets of K_{4,4}, retaining precisely the 7,342 sets with all four row and all four column degrees at most two. The face vector is (16,120,528,1428,2304,2040,816,90). Independently replayed the stated 16-edge toggle order, obtaining 3,663 disjoint face-poset pairs, one critical vertex, fifteen critical 5-faces, and zero other critical faces. Oriented all 37,728 nonempty-face Hasse covers and completely topologically sorted the 7,342-node directed graph; it is acyclic. Forman discrete Morse therefore yields a CW complex with only one 0-cell and fifteen 5-cells. All attaching maps S^4->point are null, so the asserted integral wedge homotopy type follows. Boundary ranks and the saved certificate are corroborative, not substituted for this complete acyclicity certificate. No assertion about larger K_{n,n} or equivariant action.
